reuse.why: Reuses recurrence conversion and weekend adjustment helpers, but repeats daily skipping decisions instead of sharing the occurrence policy.

duplication.why: The daily skip-versus-shift decision appears independently in getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, and getDatesInRange.

placement.why: Holiday matching belongs in shared/schedules.ts, but server handlers also own recurrence policy that should live in that shared layer.

scope.why: The edits are focused on schedule occurrence handling, the range endpoint, configuration propagation, and related tests.

maintainability.why: Maintainers must coordinate several policy implementations, separate iteration strategies, and unexplained limits of 14 and 366.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange implement occurrence policy outside getNextDate; schedule-template.ts retains two raw-date paths that disable getNextDate adjustment and apply shifting themselves.

disguised_duplication.where: The same daily skip-versus-shift policy is reshaped as an advancing loop in getNextDate and nullable mappings returning Dates or day strings in the two server handlers.

abstraction_drift.where: getDateWithSkippedWeekend gains holidays; getNextDate gains daily-specific empty-result recovery and daily dispatch; two server handlers and two budget adjustment sites independently apply occurrence policy.
